schema:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE settings (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
)

CREATE TABLE sequences (
  name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  last_value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_value >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE product_groups (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
, markup_bp INTEGER CHECK (markup_bp IS NULL OR (markup_bp >= 0 AND markup_bp <= 100000)))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_product_groups_name ON product_groups (name)

CREATE TABLE warehouses (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_warehouses_name ON warehouses (name)

CREATE TABLE customers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  phone TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  is_system INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_system IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_customers_name ON customers (name)

CREATE TABLE suppliers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  phone TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
, is_system INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_system IN (0, 1)))
CREATE INDEX ix_suppliers_name ON suppliers (name)

CREATE TABLE payments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sales_invoice_id TEXT REFERENCES sales_invoices (id),
  purchase_invoice_id TEXT REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id),
  amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((sales_invoice_id IS NULL) <> (purchase_invoice_id IS NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_payments_sales ON payments (sales_invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_payments_purchase ON payments (purchase_invoice_id)

CREATE TABLE units (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  allows_fraction INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (allows_fraction IN (0, 1)),
  is_system INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_system IN (0, 1)),
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_units_name ON units (name)

CREATE TABLE "warehouse_stock" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_stock_wh_product ON warehouse_stock (warehouse_id, product_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_stock_product ON warehouse_stock (product_id)

CREATE TABLE "purchase_invoices" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reference TEXT,
  invoice_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  subtotal_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_amount >= 0),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  total_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  supplier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (discount <= subtotal_amount),
  CHECK (total_amount = subtotal_amount - discount)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_purchase_number ON purchase_invoices (invoice_number)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_date ON purchase_invoices (invoice_date)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_supplier ON purchase_invoices (supplier_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_warehouse ON purchase_invoices (warehouse_id)

CREATE TABLE "purchase_items" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  line_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT, invoice_discount_share INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (invoice_discount_share >= 0), line_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (line_no >= 0),
  CHECK (discount <= (quantity * unit_price + 500) / 1000),
  CHECK (line_total = (quantity * unit_price + 500) / 1000 - discount)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_items_invoice ON purchase_items (invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_items_product ON purchase_items (product_id)

CREATE TABLE "sales_invoices" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reference TEXT,
  invoice_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  subtotal_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_amount >= 0),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  total_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (discount <= subtotal_amount),
  CHECK (total_amount = subtotal_amount - discount)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_sales_number ON sales_invoices (invoice_number)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_date ON sales_invoices (invoice_date)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_customer ON sales_invoices (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_warehouse ON sales_invoices (warehouse_id)

CREATE TABLE "sales_items" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  line_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT, invoice_discount_share INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (invoice_discount_share >= 0), line_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (line_no >= 0), cost_fifo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_fifo >= 0), cost_average INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_average >= 0), cost_last INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_last >= 0),
  CHECK (discount <= (quantity * unit_price + 500) / 1000),
  CHECK (line_total = (quantity * unit_price + 500) / 1000 - discount)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_items_invoice ON sales_items (invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_items_product ON sales_items (product_id)

CREATE TABLE "stock_movements" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  quantity_delta INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_delta <> 0),
  movement_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (movement_type IN ('purchase', 'sale_cancel', 'sale_return', 'transfer_in', 'adjustment', 'opening', 'sale', 'purchase_cancel', 'purchase_return', 'transfer_out', 'shortage', 'waste')),
  document_type TEXT CHECK (document_type IS NULL OR document_type IN (
    'purchase_invoice', 'sales_invoice', 'transfer', 'adjustment')),
  document_id TEXT,
  document_line_id TEXT,
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  cost_fifo INTEGER CHECK (cost_fifo IS NULL OR cost_fifo >= 0),
  cost_average INTEGER CHECK (cost_average IS NULL OR cost_average >= 0),
  cost_last INTEGER CHECK (cost_last IS NULL OR cost_last >= 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((document_type IS NULL) = (document_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (document_line_id IS NULL OR document_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK ((cost_fifo IS NULL) = (cost_average IS NULL) AND (cost_fifo IS NULL) = (cost_last IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((movement_type IN ('purchase', 'sale_cancel', 'sale_return', 'transfer_in', 'adjustment', 'opening') AND quantity_delta > 0) OR (movement_type IN ('sale', 'purchase_cancel', 'purchase_return', 'transfer_out', 'shortage', 'waste') AND quantity_delta < 0))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_movements_product_wh ON stock_movements (product_id, warehouse_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_movements_document ON stock_movements (document_type, document_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_movements_line ON stock_movements (document_line_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_movements_date ON stock_movements (occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE cost_lots (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  movement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_movements (id),
  lot_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  remaining INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (remaining >= 0 AND remaining <= quantity),
  total_cost INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_cost >= 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_lots_movement ON cost_lots (movement_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_lots_fifo ON cost_lots (product_id, warehouse_id, lot_date, created_at)

CREATE TABLE lot_allocations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  lot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cost_lots (id),
  movement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_movements (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  cost_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_amount >= 0),
  reversal_movement_id TEXT REFERENCES stock_movements (id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_alloc_lot ON lot_allocations (lot_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_alloc_movement ON lot_allocations (movement_id)

CREATE TABLE average_costs (
  product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0),
  value INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (value >= 0),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
)

CREATE TABLE "products" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(code)) > 0),
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  group_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_groups (id),
  unit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (id),
  sub_unit TEXT,
  conversion_ratio INTEGER CHECK (conversion_ratio IS NULL OR conversion_ratio > 0),
  reorder_point INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reorder_point >= 0),
  sale_price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sale_price >= 0),
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((sub_unit IS NULL) = (conversion_ratio IS NULL))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_products_code ON products (code)
CREATE INDEX ix_products_name ON products (name)
CREATE INDEX ix_products_group ON products (group_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_products_unit ON products (unit_id)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_stock_no_negative_insert BEFORE INSERT ON warehouse_stock
WHEN NEW.quantity < 0
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'negative_stock'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_stock_no_negative_update BEFORE UPDATE OF quantity ON warehouse_stock
WHEN NEW.quantity < 0
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'negative_stock'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_movements_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON stock_movements
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_movements_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON stock_movements
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_movements_whole_units BEFORE INSERT ON stock_movements
WHEN NEW.quantity_delta % 1000 <> 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p JOIN units u ON u.id = p.unit_id WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id AND u.allows_fraction = 0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'fraction_not_allowed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_invoices_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON sales_invoices
WHEN OLD.status = 'cancelled'
  OR NEW.invoice_number IS NOT OLD.invoice_number
  OR NEW.invoice_date IS NOT OLD.invoice_date
  OR NEW.customer_id IS NOT OLD.customer_id
  OR NEW.warehouse_id IS NOT OLD.warehouse_id
  OR NEW.subtotal_amount IS NOT OLD.subtotal_amount
  OR NEW.discount IS NOT OLD.discount
  OR NEW.total_amount IS NOT OLD.total_amount
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sales_invoices
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_items_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON sales_items
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_items_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sales_items
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_items_only_active BEFORE INSERT ON sales_items
WHEN (SELECT status FROM sales_invoices WHERE id = NEW.invoice_id) = 'cancelled'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_items_whole_units BEFORE INSERT ON sales_items
WHEN NEW.quantity % 1000 <> 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p JOIN units u ON u.id = p.unit_id WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id AND u.allows_fraction = 0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'fraction_not_allowed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sales_items_share_limit BEFORE INSERT ON sales_items
WHEN NEW.invoice_discount_share > NEW.line_total
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'amount_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_invoices_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON purchase_invoices
WHEN OLD.status = 'cancelled'
  OR NEW.invoice_number IS NOT OLD.invoice_number
  OR NEW.invoice_date IS NOT OLD.invoice_date
  OR NEW.supplier_id IS NOT OLD.supplier_id
  OR NEW.warehouse_id IS NOT OLD.warehouse_id
  OR NEW.subtotal_amount IS NOT OLD.subtotal_amount
  OR NEW.discount IS NOT OLD.discount
  OR NEW.total_amount IS NOT OLD.total_amount
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON purchase_invoices
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_items_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON purchase_items
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_items_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON purchase_items
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_items_only_active BEFORE INSERT ON purchase_items
WHEN (SELECT status FROM purchase_invoices WHERE id = NEW.invoice_id) = 'cancelled'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_items_whole_units BEFORE INSERT ON purchase_items
WHEN NEW.quantity % 1000 <> 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p JOIN units u ON u.id = p.unit_id WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id AND u.allows_fraction = 0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'fraction_not_allowed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchase_items_share_limit BEFORE INSERT ON purchase_items
WHEN NEW.invoice_discount_share > NEW.line_total
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'amount_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_unit_locked BEFORE UPDATE OF unit_id ON products
WHEN NEW.unit_id <> OLD.unit_id AND (
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements WHERE product_id = OLD.id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_items WHERE product_id = OLD.id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_items WHERE product_id = OLD.id))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'unit_locked'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_units_fraction_locked BEFORE UPDATE OF allows_fraction ON units
WHEN NEW.allows_fraction <> OLD.allows_fraction AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE unit_id = OLD.id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'unit_locked'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_units_system_update BEFORE UPDATE ON units
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1 AND (NEW.is_active = 0 OR NEW.is_system = 0 OR NEW.name <> OLD.name OR NEW.allows_fraction <> OLD.allows_fraction)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_units_system_delete BEFORE DELETE ON units
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_customers_system_update BEFORE UPDATE ON customers
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1 AND (NEW.is_active = 0 OR NEW.is_system = 0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_customers_system_delete BEFORE DELETE ON customers
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_suppliers_system_update BEFORE UPDATE ON suppliers
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1 AND (NEW.is_active = 0 OR NEW.is_system = 0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_suppliers_system_delete BEFORE DELETE ON suppliers
WHEN OLD.is_system = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'system_row_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_lots_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON cost_lots
WHEN NEW.product_id IS NOT OLD.product_id OR NEW.warehouse_id IS NOT OLD.warehouse_id OR NEW.movement_id IS NOT OLD.movement_id
  OR NEW.lot_date IS NOT OLD.lot_date OR NEW.quantity IS NOT OLD.quantity OR NEW.total_cost IS NOT OLD.total_cost
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_lots_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cost_lots
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_alloc_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON lot_allocations
WHEN NEW.lot_id IS NOT OLD.lot_id OR NEW.movement_id IS NOT OLD.movement_id OR NEW.quantity IS NOT OLD.quantity
  OR NEW.cost_amount IS NOT OLD.cost_amount OR OLD.reversal_movement_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reversal_movement_id IS NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_alloc_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON lot_allocations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE expenses (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('rent', 'salary', 'bills', 'transport', 'other')),
  amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0 AND amount <= 1000000000000000),
  expense_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_date ON expenses (expense_date)
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_category ON expenses (category)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_expenses_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON expenses
WHEN OLD.status = 'cancelled'
  OR NEW.category IS NOT OLD.category
  OR NEW.amount IS NOT OLD.amount
  OR NEW.expense_date IS NOT OLD.expense_date
  OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_expenses_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON expenses
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document_immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE sale_returns (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  return_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sales_invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id),
  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
  doc_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  total_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_sale_returns_number ON sale_returns (return_number)
CREATE INDEX ix_sale_returns_invoice ON sale_returns (sales_invoice_id)

CREATE TABLE sale_return_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  return_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns (id),
  sales_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_items (id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  line_total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total >= 0),
  cost_fifo INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_fifo >= 0),
  cost_average INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_average >= 0),
  cost_last INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_last >= 0),
  line_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_sale_return_items_return ON sale_return_items (return_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sale_return_items_sales_item ON sale_return_items (sales_item_id)

CREATE TABLE purchase_returns (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  return_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),

  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
)

  line_total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total >= 0),
  cost_fifo INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_fifo >= 0),
  cost_average INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_average >= 0),
  cost_last INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cost_last >= 0),
  line_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_return_items_return ON purchase_return_items (return_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_purchase_return_items_pi ON purchase_return_items (purchase_item_id)

CREATE TABLE warehouse_transfers (

  from_warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),

  doc_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),

  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)),

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_transfers_number ON warehouse_transfers (transfer_number)

CREATE TABLE warehouse_transfer_items (
